# Agent Skill Catalog

> A local-first, read-only catalog for Agent Skills and Codex plugins. Search the agent skills you already installed.

Updated: 2026-11-12

## Canonical pages

- English overview: https://mianbaofang.github.io/agent-skill-catalog/
- Chinese overview: https://mianbaofang.github.io/agent-skill-catalog/index-zh.html
- Guide: search installed skills (English): https://mianbaofang.github.io/agent-skill-catalog/guides/search-installed-skills.html
- Guide: search installed skills (Chinese): https://mianbaofang.github.io/agent-skill-catalog/guides/search-installed-skills-zh.html
- Guide: offline skill catalog (English): https://mianbaofang.github.io/agent-skill-catalog/guides/offline-skill-catalog.html
- Guide: offline skill catalog (Chinese): https://mianbaofang.github.io/agent-skill-catalog/guides/offline-skill-catalog-zh.html
- Guide: skills and plugin inventory (English): https://mianbaofang.github.io/agent-skill-catalog/guides/skills-and-plugin-inventory.html
- Guide: skills and plugin inventory (Chinese): https://mianbaofang.github.io/agent-skill-catalog/guides/skills-and-plugin-inventory-zh.html
- Source repository: https://github.com/mianbaofang/agent-skill-catalog
- Installable Skill: https://github.com/mianbaofang/agent-skill-catalog/tree/main/skills/agent-skill-catalog
- Current tagged release: https://github.com/mianbaofang/agent-skill-catalog/releases/tag/v0.4.0

## What it does

- Scans only explicit local `SKILL.md` roots and optional plugin roots.
- Keeps standalone Skills, parent-child families, and plugin aggregates distinct.
- Deduplicates repository-backed copies across scan roots while preserving their locations.
- Optionally fetches one preview per observed GitHub repository and reuses it for matching records.
- Gives the invoking Agent a resumable evidence queue for missing Chinese descriptions.
- Shows invocation wording, classification evidence, GitHub repository links, and image provenance.
- Generates a self-contained desktop HTML catalog and can refresh it through a localhost-only server.

## Boundaries

- The build does not install, execute, or edit scanned Skills.
- The optional local server can permanently delete a top-level standalone Skill directory, but only after `allow_delete` is set to `true` for that root and the full Skill name is confirmed; family and plugin entries are excluded.
- A default build is not guaranteed offline. It may send Skill names to GitHub repository search and fetch public previews.
- The generated catalog interface is currently Chinese; repository documentation is English and Chinese.
- Search is substring matching over names, descriptions, GitHub metadata, and source-relative paths, not semantic search.
- Missing image or description evidence stays labeled as missing evidence.

## Install

Install the stable release, pinned to `v0.4.0`:

```powershell
gh skill install mianbaofang/agent-skill-catalog agent-skill-catalog --pin v0.4.0 --agent codex --scope user
```

Contributors and maintainers can install the current source on `main`:

```powershell
gh skill install mianbaofang/agent-skill-catalog agent-skill-catalog --pin main --agent codex --scope user
```

## Offline build

```powershell
python skills/agent-skill-catalog/scripts/build_catalog.py --root "C:\path\to\skills" --output-dir "C:\path\to\catalog-output" --no-github-discovery --no-github-images
```

Add `--require-complete-descriptions` for the enriched catalog; exit code 3 means Chinese descriptions are still pending.
